aboutPage.metaTitle: About Serenova | Personal Tanzania Safari Planning
aboutPage.metaDescription: Meet Jenny, the founder of Serenova, a Lausanne-based travel brand creating personalised journeys through Tanzania and Zanzibar with trusted local partners.
aboutPage.title: About Serenova
aboutPage.lede: A more personal way to experience Africa.
aboutPage.founderBody1: I created Serenova from a genuine love of Tanzania and Zanzibar, and the belief that travel can be both memorable and meaningful. I travelled there to discover the destination and returned knowing that part of my heart would always remain.
aboutPage.founderBody2: Today, I hope to help other people discover their own connection to these extraordinary places.
aboutPage.storyBody: Serenova is based in Lausanne, Switzerland, but its inspiration began much further south, with a deep affection for Tanzania and Zanzibar. What started as travel and discovery became something more lasting: a wish to share these places in a thoughtful, personal way. From expansive savannahs and remarkable wildlife to the warmth of local encounters and the beauty of the Indian Ocean, the experiences stayed with me long after I returned home.
aboutPage.approachBody: I believe a wonderful journey begins with a conversation. I want to understand your interests, what excites you, how you like to travel and the details that matter to you. Whether this is your first visit to Tanzania or somewhere you have long hoped to return to, my aim is to help shape an experience that feels considered and individual.
aboutPage.partnersBody: Serenova works with trusted local partners based in Arusha and across Tanzania and Zanzibar. Their on-the-ground knowledge and practical experience help bring each journey together, from safari arrangements and local guiding to selected activities and transfers.
aboutPage.ctaBody: Tell us when you would like to travel, who is joining you and what you hope to experience.

zanzibarPage.title: Zanzibar
zanzibarPage.lede: Beaches, culture and unforgettable island days — after the bush, or as a journey of its own.
zanzibarPage.caption: The islands
zanzibarPage.waterBody: Best time: June to October and January to February are generally the kindest beach months. March to May is usually wetter. Spice tours, Jozani Forest, Mnemba Atoll and Stone Town can be arranged with trusted local partners.
zanzibarPage.stayBody: The Mora is one Zanzibar address in Jenny’s library — chosen when the coast, the pace and the rooms feel right. Other beaches and properties are composed around you.
zanzibarPage.nungwiText: Vibrant and festive. Famous for sunsets, clear water, swimming and a wide range of water activities.
zanzibarPage.pajeText: Sporty and bohemian. Long white-sand beaches, fishing villages and a laid-back coast.
zanzibarPage.matemweText: Exclusive and peaceful. A quieter escape, with snorkelling near Mnemba Atoll.
zanzibarPage.stoneText: Winding alleys, carved doors, a UNESCO town of Swahili architecture and living culture.

kilimanjaroPage.mountainBody: Rising to 5,895 metres, Kilimanjaro is a profound, life-changing walk: rainforest, alpine desert, then a summit that rewards you with light and silence. Serenova composes the route around your fitness, time and pace.

whyPage.metaTitle: Why Travel with Serenova | Tailor-Made Tanzania Safaris
whyPage.metaDescription: Discover Serenova’s personal approach to Tanzania safari planning, carefully selected local partners, tailored itineraries and thoughtful travel guidance.
whyPage.title: Why travel with Serenova?
whyPage.lede: More than a safari. A journey shaped by passion, trust and personal attention.
whyPage.intro: At Serenova, we believe travel is about more than reaching a destination. It is about discovering extraordinary places in a way that feels natural, personal and rewarding. Our role is to listen, advise and connect the details so that you can enjoy the journey itself.

passion.title: Passion & personal experience
passion.body: Serenova grew from a genuine appreciation for Tanzania and Zanzibar. That connection shapes our approach: warm, engaged and attentive to what makes each trip meaningful.

partners.title: Trusted local partners
partners.body: We work closely with selected partners in Arusha and beyond, including experienced safari professionals and service providers. Their local insight plays an important part in thoughtful planning.

guides.title: Experienced local guides
guides.body: Guides make a profound difference to a safari. Local knowledge, interpretation of animal behaviour and respectful guiding help turn a wildlife sighting into a deeper understanding of the place.

tailored.title: Tailor-made journeys
tailored.body: Your route can reflect what interests you most: classic game drives, landscapes and photography, family-friendly pacing, romantic accommodation, cultural experiences or a Zanzibar extension.

nature.title: Respect for nature & wildlife
nature.body: Wildlife deserves space. We favour responsible encounters and encourage travellers to follow park regulations, respect communities and minimise avoidable environmental impact.

more.title: More than safari
more.body: A journey may include both mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar, with time for beaches, culture, scenic travel and places that reveal a different side of the region.

guidance.title: Personal guidance, step by step
guidance.body: From your initial questions to preparations before departure, we aim to make the process understandable and personal. We explain choices, discuss the practical details and help you prepare for what to expect.

memory.title: Experiences you’ll remember
memory.body: No journey needs to promise the impossible. The joy lies in well-considered details, remarkable landscapes and moments that feel entirely your own.

whyPage.closeTitle: Your journey is personal to us
whyPage.closeBody: We listen first, then compose with trusted local partners — so the days can reflect what matters to you.
whyPage.ctaBody: Tell us when you would like to travel, who is joining you and what you hope to experience.

tanzania.name: Tanzania
tanzania.lede: Iconic wildlife, open landscapes and unforgettable safari days.
body: From the northern circuit to quieter southern parks, Tanzania is the heart of Serenova’s work. Each journey is written around you — never held as stock.

zanzibar.name: Zanzibar
zanzibar.lede: Turquoise water, pale sand and a deep Swahili heritage.
body: Often the breath after safari — sometimes the journey itself. Nungwi, Kendwa, Paje, Matemwe and Stone Town, composed with trusted local partners.

kenya.name: Kenya
kenya.lede: Vast savannas and iconic wildlife, from the Masai Mara to quieter north.
body: Kenya is a land of extraordinary contrast. Serenova designs tailor-made safaris here with trusted local contacts.
For a Kenya journey, please write to Jenny directly. This is not a catalogue.

uganda.name: Uganda
uganda.lede: Forests, highland gorillas and lakes — a page of intention, not a departure grid.
body: Uganda is lush forest, dramatic highland and rare primate encounters, from Bwindi to Queen Elizabeth National Park and Murchison Falls.
For a Uganda journey, please contact Jenny directly.

halal-friendly.name: Halal-Friendly Safari
halal-friendly.summary: Travel in a way that respects your faith and personal priorities. We can discuss meal preferences, opportunities for prayer, privacy and a comfortable itinerary in advance. Specific arrangements depend on your chosen route and accommodation and are confirmed before booking.
halal-friendly.note: Meal preferences, prayer, privacy and a comfortable itinerary can be discussed in advance. Nothing is assumed, and essential arrangements are confirmed before booking.

fly-in.name: Fly-In Safari
fly-in.summary: See more of Tanzania with less time spent on long road transfers. Where routes and flight schedules allow, domestic flights can connect you with remote safari areas and extraordinary landscapes.
fly-in.note: A fly-in journey offers an appealing balance of adventure, convenience and time in nature — subject to routes and flight schedules.

walking.name: Walking Safari
walking.summary: Experience the bush from a different perspective. Accompanied by qualified local guides in authorised areas, a walking safari reveals tracks, birdlife, plants and the subtle details often missed from a vehicle.
walking.chapter: At the pace of the land
walking.note: Routes, age requirements and availability depend on park rules and safety conditions.

photography.name: Photography Safari
photography.summary: For photographers, timing changes everything. A carefully paced safari gives you opportunities to consider light, positioning and animal behaviour rather than rushing between sightings.
photography.note: From first-time enthusiasts to dedicated wildlife photographers, the itinerary can reflect your goals. Specialised vehicles or guides, if requested, depend on availability.

honeymoon.name: Honeymoon Safari
honeymoon.summary: Begin a new chapter amid breathtaking landscapes and moments designed to be shared. Think unhurried game drives, inviting lodges, memorable sunsets and perhaps a few restorative days beside the Indian Ocean.
honeymoon.chapter: Two people, a very large landscape
honeymoon.note: Your honeymoon is shaped around the experiences that feel right for you both — adventure, rest, privacy and the pace you prefer.

family.name: Family Safari
family.summary: Introduce younger travellers to the wonder of the natural world. A family safari can balance wildlife encounters with shorter drives, comfortable stays, rest time and activities suited to different ages.
family.chapter: Wilderness that still works with children
family.note: We help you explore the practical details before choosing your route. Child policies and activity limits are confirmed with each supplier.

beach-zanzibar.name: Beach & Zanzibar Holiday
beach-zanzibar.summary: From Stone Town’s cultural heritage to the island’s remarkable coastline, Zanzibar brings another dimension to an East African journey. Enjoy warm-water relaxation, local flavours, coastal discoveries and time to slow down.
beach-zanzibar.note: Beach conditions vary by coastline and season. The right coast depends on how you like to spend your days.

great-migration.name: Great Migration Safari
great-migration.summary: Follow one of the world’s most extraordinary wildlife movements. Across the Serengeti ecosystem, herds respond to rainfall and the search for grazing.
great-migration.note: We plan around seasonal patterns while recognising that animal movements and river crossings can never be guaranteed.

serengeti.name: Serengeti National Park
serengeti.summary: UNESCO plains, the migration, and one of Africa’s great wildlife theatres.

ngorongoro.summary: The world’s largest intact volcanic caldera, dense with wildlife.

tarangire.name: Tarangire National Park
tarangire.summary: Elephant herds, ancient baobabs and a more intimate northern park.

lake-manyara.summary: A compact rift-valley park of forest, lake and famous tree-climbing lions.

lake-natron.name: Lake Natron

saadani.name: Saadani National Park
saadani.summary: Where bush meets the Indian Ocean.

kitulo.name: Kitulo National Park
kitulo.summary: A highland park of wildflowers, often called the Serengeti of flowers.

nyerere.name: Nyerere National Park
nyerere.summary: One of Africa’s largest parks: river, boat safari and wild southern Tanzania.

ruaha.name: Ruaha National Park
ruaha.summary: A vast, less-visited southern park of baobabs, lions and the Great Ruaha River.

mikumi.name: Mikumi National Park
mikumi.summary: An accessible southern park on the road toward Nyerere and the coast.

udzungwa.name: Udzungwa Mountains National Park
udzungwa.summary: Eastern-arc rainforest, endemic primates and waterfall walks.

katavi.name: Katavi National Park
katavi.summary: One of Tanzania’s wildest and least-visited parks.

mahale.name: Mahale Mountains National Park
mahale.summary: Lake Tanganyika and habituated chimpanzees on forested slopes.

gombe.name: Gombe Stream National Park
gombe.summary: Jane Goodall’s lakeshore forest — intimate chimpanzee tracking.

bagamoyo.name: Bagamoyo
bagamoyo.summary: A historic coastal town of stone, dhows and Swahili memory.
